text: oh. so the library, you can edit that part out. let me show u why. [Image #1] this is my ui. its now double
resolution: Removed the duplicate column-3 LIBRARY panel and moved model delete onto the roster row itself + added a copy button to the SHAPE data face. USER showed the column-3 LIBRARY panel duplicated the column-2 roster ('is now double'). Fix: the delete affordance now lives ON the roster row. The shell RosterRow shape stayed {id,label,icon}; the capability went on WorkbenchSource as canDeleteRow?(id)/onDeleteRow?(id), and shell/Workbench.tsx renders a per-row trash ✕ with a two-step inline confirm (confirmDeleteId shell state, reset on source switch). Frontmost-leaf hit-test means the inner ✕ takes the click without firing the row's select (the LayerStrip row-button precedent). The Studio source sets canDeleteRow = rowId.startsWith('model:') (exempts '+ new') + onDeleteRow -> studioDeleteModel. Deleted ModelManagePanel.tsx (the duplicate). Also added a 'copy' button on the SHAPE panel's encoded-JSON row -> @reactjit/hooks/clipboard set(json) with a 1.2s 'copied ✓' flash (USER: 'a copy button on the data face would be nice'). editMesh 48/48, modelStream 8/8, Studio + shell + full sources chain bundle clean. Hot-reload TSX, nothing committed (user leads commits).
